Referral Offer Terms

Effective November 17, 2026 · MeND Sourcing Solutions LLC ("GovScraper", "we", "us")

You were invited to GovScraper through a member's referral link. These terms explain what the offer includes and who qualifies.

Your offer: a 14-day free trial of GovScraper — double the standard 7-day trial — applied automatically when you sign up through your invite link. No charge until your trial ends.

1. Who qualifies

  • The extended trial is for new customers only. If you have had a GovScraper account or trial before, or your company already has an account, the standard trial applies instead.
  • One extended trial per person and per company.
  • You must sign up through the referral link (or enter the referral code at signup) for the offer to apply.

2. How the trial works

  • Your 14-day trial starts the day you create your account and includes full access to the plan you select.
  • You will not be charged during the trial. Cancel anytime before it ends and you pay nothing.
  • When the trial ends, your subscription begins at the standard price of the plan you chose.

3. About the person who invited you

GovScraper members earn a $100 account credit when someone they invite subscribes to a PRO plan or above and completes their first payment. Your invite link tells us who to thank — it does not affect your pricing, your data, or what you see in GovScraper, and the member never sees your account activity.

4. Fair use

  • Creating multiple accounts, or signing up your own company through your own link, voids the offer.
  • We may withhold or withdraw the offer where we reasonably determine fraud or abuse.

5. Changes

We may modify or end the referral offer at any time. If you signed up while the offer was active, your trial is honored as described at signup.

6. Questions

Email tristan@govscraper.com. These terms supplement the GovScraper Terms of Service, which govern your use of the platform.
